name: realreel-c2pa
description: Open-source RealReel C2PA trust core, verifier microservice, native capture module, and CA edge functions.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:deno && npm run lint:native && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:fix: scripts/lint-deno.sh --fix && npm run lint:fix --workspace native && npm run lint:ts -- --fix
scripts.test: npm run build -w trust-core && npm run test:trust-core && npm run typecheck:verifier && npm run test:verifier && npm run test:ca && npm run test:pki && npm run test:ocsp && npm run test:ocsp-leaf && npm run test:native
